body:
## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Tomar, Portugal. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 10 km. It starts at Convent of Christ, Estrada do Convento, 8. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Entrance ticket to Convent of Christ. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone. WeGoTrip names Kseniya as the tour's author.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Immerse yourself in the legacy of knights and navigators with this self-guided audio tour of Tomar. The journey begins at the majestic Convent of Christ, slowly unfurling the architectural and historical marvels of Tomar. Please note that while the entry ticket is included, the audio guide inside the Convent is not provided within this bundle.
>
> After you finish exploring the Convent, continue your walk with an audio tour through Tomar. From the storied walls of the Templar Castle to the tranquil corridors of the Convento de São Francisco, the route guides you through cobblestoned paths and lush gardens, culminating at the Church of Santa Maria do Olival. Along the way, the tour traverses bustling squares, silent synagogues, and monuments steeped in remembrance, painting a full picture of a city's storied evolution.
>
> This audio experience ensures each traveler understands the significance of what they see, connecting the physical splendors with the rich tapestry of Tomar's historical narrative. Ending your journey, you'll be left with vivid memories of standing where knights once strode, of quiet reflections in chapels aged with prayer, and indelible impressions of the city's timeless dance with history. Enveloped in the aura of this ancient town, each traveler will depart with a deeper appreciation of the human journey etched into the heritage of Tomar.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €21.50. It was rated 4.5 out of 5 from 242 ratings and 138 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from
